trigger: Seal the shelter (seal_shelter event; sets shelter_sealed).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Plastic sheeting from Gil's truck. Duct tape from Dutch's last stock. Every window, every vent.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Heat stays in, ash stays out. And something else, maitia. Something else stays out.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: The things on the ridge. They walk past sealed houses. Salt told me. He's not as crazy as he smells.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The house goes dim and close. SEAL: 100%. Every crack you missed will show up eventually.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Lolo's clinic first, then yours. It costs you an afternoon and half the tape. Both hold.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: That night, something walks the length of the street. It pauses at the Henleys' unsealed house. Then it goes in.
